title: Controlled prescription has a legitimate medical purpose
proposedRule: Issue a controlled-substance prescription only for a legitimate medical purpose.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: clinical-purpose attestation and accountable prescriber; clinical legitimacy cannot be proved by field presence
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. A diagnosis or indication alone cannot establish legitimate purpose. V1 has no dedicated controlled-prescription attestation.

title: Prescriber acts in usual professional practice
quote: usual course of his professional practice
proposedRule: Permit controlled prescribing only in the usual course of the individual practitioner’s professional practice.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: professional-scope and clinical review beyond UI conformance
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. Separate legal condition from legitimate medical purpose; no automatic claim of clinical correctness.

title: Prescription bears its actual issue date
quote: dated as of, and signed on, the day when issued
proposedRule: Date each controlled-substance prescription as of the day it is issued; prevent future dating to implement delayed fills.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: prescription issue-date field and same-day signing validation
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes full patient name
proposedRule: Include the patient’s full name in each controlled-substance prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: full patient name in outgoing prescription
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. V1 patientBanner is chart information, not a guarantee of complete outgoing prescription content.

title: Prescription includes patient address
proposedRule: Include the patient’s address in each controlled-substance prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: patient address in outgoing prescription
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. V1 patientBanner is chart information, not a guarantee of complete outgoing prescription content.

title: Prescription includes drug name
proposedRule: Capture the drug name on each controlled-substance prescription line.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. V1 medication-order requirements map to signOrders and signPreOpOrders; approveRefill uses separate refill elements.

title: Prescription includes product strength
proposedRule: Include the controlled drug’s product strength in the prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: product strength distinct from prescribed dose
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes dosage form
proposedRule: Include the controlled drug’s dosage form in the prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: explicit dosage-form field
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes quantity
proposedRule: Capture the quantity prescribed for each controlled-substance prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. V1 medication-order requirements map to signOrders and signPreOpOrders; approveRefill uses separate refill elements.

title: Prescription includes directions for use
proposedRule: Include directions for use on every controlled-substance prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: complete outgoing prescription directions assembled from dose, doseUnit, route, freq and prn
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes prescriber name
quote: name, address and registration number of the practitioner
proposedRule: Include the prescribing practitioner’s name in the prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: prescriber legal name in outgoing prescription
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes prescriber address
proposedRule: Include the prescribing practitioner’s address in the prescription.

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: prescriber address in outgoing prescription
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescription includes DEA registration
proposedRule: Include the practitioner’s DEA registration number, subject to the institutional and government exceptions in §1306.05(g)–(h).

specMapping.when: controlled-substance outpatient or discharge prescription (Schedules II–V)

needsCoreFeature: DEA number or applicable statutory substitute in outgoing prescription
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: GHB prescription states medical need
proposedRule: When prescribing gamma-hydroxybutyric acid, note the patient’s medical need on the face of the prescription.

specMapping.when: gamma-hydroxybutyric acid prescription

needsCoreFeature: GHB-specific required-entry condition and outgoing face-of-prescription placement
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. The indication element exists but is optional in V1; the federal rule is drug-specific.

title: Exempt hospital prescriber uses institutional internal code
proposedRule: For a practitioner exempt under §1301.22(c), include the hospital’s DEA number and the practitioner’s assigned internal code in place of an individual DEA number.

specMapping.when: hospital-exempt individual practitioner under §1301.22(c)

needsCoreFeature: institutional DEA number plus practitioner internal-code binding
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Emergency oral Schedule II supply covers emergency only
proposedRule: For a legally qualifying emergency oral Schedule II prescription, limit the quantity to the amount adequate for the emergency period.

specMapping.when: qualifying emergency oral Schedule II prescription

needsCoreFeature: emergency oral prescription channel and emergency-duration quantity validation
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. The general paper/electronic rules and special fax exceptions remain applicable; emergency status is defined in §290.10.

title: Emergency oral Schedule II prescription has seven-day follow-up
proposedRule: After an emergency oral Schedule II authorization, cause the required follow-up prescription to be delivered to the dispensing pharmacist within seven days.

specMapping.when: qualifying emergency oral Schedule II prescription

needsCoreFeature: follow-up task with seven-day deadline and delivery/postmark evidence
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. Mail must be postmarked within seven days. For electronic follow-up the pharmacist annotates the original authorization and oral-order date.

title: Emergency follow-up carries emergency authorization notation
proposedRule: Include the required emergency-dispensing authorization notation on the follow-up prescription for an emergency oral Schedule II order.

specMapping.when: follow-up to qualifying emergency oral Schedule II prescription

needsCoreFeature: emergency follow-up prescription notation
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. The date of the oral order is a separate required item in the same paragraph.

title: Schedule II prescription cannot have refills
proposedRule: Reject any Schedule II prescription or refill approval that authorizes a refill; use a new prescription when appropriate.

specMapping.when: Schedule II prescription or refill request

needsCoreFeature: Schedule II numeric value constraint refills = 0, including refillRefills
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. Already discussed in regulations.md C4 and BRIEF; V1 requires refills but does not constrain its value. existingInSpec is therefore false.

title: Multiple Schedule II prescriptions total at most 90 days
proposedRule: When issuing multiple Schedule II prescriptions under this permission, limit their combined supply to 90 days.

specMapping.when: multiple Schedule II prescriptions issued under §1306.12(b)

needsCoreFeature: linked prescription series and aggregate days-supply constraint
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. This is permission subject to all listed conditions, not a required visit interval or a general federal single-prescription day-supply limit.

title: Later Schedule II prescriptions carry earliest fill dates
proposedRule: For each prescription in a multiple-Schedule-II series, write the earliest pharmacy fill date except for a first prescription intended for immediate filling.

specMapping.when: multiple Schedule II prescription series; except first intended for immediate fill

needsCoreFeature: earliest-fill-date field separate from actual issue date
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Prescriber assesses diversion risk for multiple prescriptions
quote: undue risk of diversion or abuse
proposedRule: Before issuing a multiple-Schedule-II series, the prescriber concludes that the arrangement does not create an undue risk of diversion or abuse.

specMapping.when: multiple Schedule II prescriptions under §1306.12(b)

needsCoreFeature: series-specific prescriber judgment attestation
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. A UI can capture the judgment, but cannot prove its clinical or legal correctness.

title: Multiple Schedule II issuance must be allowed by state law
proposedRule: Allow a multiple-Schedule-II prescription series only where applicable state law permits it.

specMapping.when: multiple Schedule II prescriptions under §1306.12(b)

needsCoreFeature: jurisdiction-aware prescription-series eligibility
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29.

title: Schedule III–IV refills expire after six months
proposedRule: Do not approve filling or refilling an original Schedule III or IV prescription more than six months after its issue date.

specMapping.when: refill of original Schedule III or IV prescription

needsCoreFeature: calendar-month expiry against original prescription issue date
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. Schedule V is not included in this paragraph. The pharmacy dispensing duty can be enforced prospectively in hospital refill approval.

title: Schedule III–IV prescriptions permit no more than five refills
proposedRule: Reject authorization of more than five total refills on the original Schedule III or IV prescription.

specMapping.when: Schedule III or IV prescription/refill authorization

needsCoreFeature: cumulative refill-count constraint across original and additional authorizations
notes: Verified 2026-10-31 against official eCFR XML as of 2026-10-29. The initial dispensing is not one of the five refills; this paragraph does not establish a Schedule V five-refill limit.
